name: Bear-to-46 Stem Disguise
formation: Okie Shell vs Gun 12 Personnel Compressed
coverage: Stem to Press Match, Eight-Man Box

summary.motive: Show a light okie shell to invite an inside-run check, then complete a cadence-length stem into a full 46 eight-man box before the ball carrier can redirect.
summary.keyDefender: SS walking from 8.5 yards into a strong-B mug — his arrival converts a two-deep picture into nine bodies at the line
summary.whyItWorks: The offense commits its protection slide and aiming points against the pre-snap shell; by the time the box is revealed, the dive is already declared.
summary.failureMode: A quick or silent count snapping the ball before the stem finishes, stranding walked safeties outside the box.

beats.title: 1. The Disguised Okie Shell
beats.text: Both safeties split at 8-9 yards with linebackers floating at 4 — the picture reads standard okie nickel spacing, not an eight-man box.

beats.title: 2. Stemming Through the Cadence
beats.text: Both safeties sprint downhill while the backers tighten behind them; eight defenders converge inside the tackles as the ball is snapped.

beats.title: 3. The Eight-Man Box Revealed
beats.text: The final picture is full 46 geometry — five linemen, tightened backers, and both walked safeties mugging the interior gaps with no numbers advantage anywhere.

beats.title: 4. Dive Into a Wall
beats.text: The checked dive hits strong A/B to find the walked safety and WILL stacked there — the stem converted a light shell into its specialty snap.

relations.tell: Both safeties are moving downhill during the cadence with backers tightening behind them — the settled goal-line Bear never moves until the snap.
